assertion.en: In the game, fixed costs were ₹10,000 and each cake used ₹300 of ingredients and a box. When the price fell from ₹500 to ₹400, more cakes had to be sold to avoid a loss.

reason.en: At a lower price, each cake leaves less money over its variable cost to pay the fixed costs.

b.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion: when each cake leaves less, more cakes are needed to pay the same fixed costs.

c.en: The Reason is true: at ₹400 a cake leaves ₹100 over its ₹300 variable cost, and at ₹500 it leaves ₹200.

d.en: The Assertion is true: at ₹500 the bakery needed 50 cakes, and at ₹400 it needed 100.

explanation.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion. At ₹500 each cake left ₹200, so 50 cakes paid the ₹10,000 of fixed costs. At ₹400 each cake left only ₹100, so 100 cakes were needed.

hints.en: Compare how much one cake leaves at each price.
